equivalence_rules: The deployment problem may be represented as a bilevel/adversarial model: upper-level chooses defense positions, lower-level replans drone paths by minimizing path cost.
Precomputing pairwise path costs or response paths is acceptable as evaluator normalization if the adversarial path response semantics are preserved.
A pure max-coverage or facility-location model without drone path replanning response is not equivalent.
algorithm_boundary: exact iterative search, encoding/decoding and evolutionary frameworks are solution algorithms; A* path planning is the opponent response evaluator, not a generic coverage constraint
public_private_boundary: All planted assignments, bandwidth plans, Pareto/deployment answers, path response traces and algorithm populations are private validation only unless explicitly defined as exogenous public scenario data.
